title: Antelope FileAccessor Resource Config
description: Schema for config.json files placed alongside source files in the FileAccessor directory tree: {DATA_ROOT}/[origin]/[interface]/[ds_type]/config.json. All fields are optional. Unknown top-level keys are passed as kwargs to the archive constructor (ds_type-specific).

priority.description: Load priority (nominally 0–100). Lower value = loaded first. Defaults: exchange=20, quantity=20, index=50, background=80.

add_interfaces.description: Additional interfaces this resource satisfies beyond the one implied by its directory position.

static.description: If true, load_all() is called on the archive immediately after initialization.

prefix.description: Path prefix used when accessing entries within a zipped/compound archive.

download.description: Specifies a remote source to download if the source file is not present locally.

md5sum.description: Optional MD5 checksum for verifying the downloaded file.

token.description: JWT for authenticating to an xdb remote archive.

config.description: ConfigureInterface specifications applied after the archive is loaded. Each key is a configuration method name; each value is a list of argument tuples (represented as arrays). All operations are idempotent. Only the options supported by the archive's ConfigureInterface implementation will be applied; unsupported options are silently skipped.

hints.description: Synonym mappings applied to the LCIA engine. Each entry is [hint_type, local_name, canonical_name].

prefixItems.description: The kind of entity being mapped.
Local name as it appears in this archive.
Canonical name in the LCIA engine.

set_reference.description: Mark a specific exchange as a reference flow. Each entry is [process_ref, flow_ref, direction]. direction may be null if unambiguous.

prefixItems.description: Exchange direction; null if there is only one candidate.

unset_reference.description: Remove a reference-flow designation. Any of the three arguments may be null to act as a wildcard.

prefixItems.description: Process external_ref, or null to match all processes.
Flow external_ref, or null to match all flows.
Exchange direction, or null to match both directions.

characterize_flow.description: Add a quantity characterization for a flow. Each entry is [flow_ref, quantity_ref, value]. Applied by ConfigureImplementation and LcConfigureImplementation.

allocate_by_quantity.description: Apply quantity-based allocation to a multi-output process at load time. Each entry is [process_ref, quantity_ref]. Applied by LcConfigureImplementation only.

prefer_provider.description: Specify a preferred provider process for a given flow. Each entry is [flow_ref, process_ref]. process_ref may be null to clear a preference.

prefixItems.description: Process external_ref, or null to remove preference.
